GeneDef.label: collective link
GeneDef.description: A subspace neural transceiver wired into the brainstem links the carrier to every other drone in their faction. Knowledge, strength and even personality flow freely through the collective.\n\nThe collective only keeps what its drones carry. Lose a drone and you lose what it knew.

customEffectDescriptions.li: Each skill is performed at the collective's best level, as long as the drone that knows it is alive and linked.
Gains stat bonuses that grow with the number of linked drones. A lone drone is isolated and weakened.
Useful traits carried by one drone are shared with all drones.
Prisoners and slaves are cut off from the collective.

GeneDef.label: subdermal exoplating
GeneDef.description: Carriers have interlocking polymer plates grown beneath the skin. The plates deflect blades and bullets.

GeneDef.label: ocular implant
GeneDef.description: One eye is replaced at the embryonic stage by a targeting laser and rangefinder, which makes aiming faster.

GeneDef.label: nanoprobe swarm
GeneDef.description: Self-replicating nanoprobes patrol the bloodstream, sealing wounds and fighting infection.

GeneDef.label: drone conditioning
GeneDef.description: Individuality is irrelevant. Carriers barely register stress, but have little interest in persuading or bargaining with anyone outside the collective.

GeneDef.label: drone skin
GeneDef.description: Carriers have the pallid, grey skin of a Slorg drone.
